impact.text: The dynamic fee system contains a cconflicting fee caps between `DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()` and `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` which renders the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective.

intent_sources.text: CLFactory.getSwapFee() threshold should be aligned with DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP (500,000) so full dynamic fees are allowed.
